name: Chilmari–Roumari reach
verdict_reasons: Erosion (3623 ha) / accretion (2505 ha) are an order of magnitude above CEGIS reference figures (hundreds of ha per reach) for a 24-day gap -- likely per-date Otsu threshold instability over a large, heterogeneous AOI rather than real bank migration. Not shipped as a confident number; see docs/PLAUSIBILITY.md.
Only 2 acquisitions available; cannot confirm a pre/post seasonal-peak pairing per methodology (Section 10.5 needs a stage peak strictly between t0 and t1).
No later acquisition available to confirm erosion/accretion persistence.
RFI screening flagged a swath-edge band on both dates; it falls outside the water channel and was not excluded from classification (see qc.json).
